comment: A review commit is scoped by the Jira key, so a spec-catchup run under that key can write behaviour outside the theme's footprint. tim theme-ticket derive excludes those by default and reports them as outsideFootprint. Where a human has judged one to be the theme's behaviour after all, it is listed here and counted. Anything not listed stays excluded, so the default is conservative and every inclusion is a recorded decision.

live-animals/journey-pages/overview/spec: Rail or road without a country of origin or a commodity has no Transit countries task
A commodity that needs identifiers with no country of origin has no identification row

plants/journey-pages/place-of-destinatio: Save and return to overview with nothing chosen reaches Overview without an error

live-animals/journey-pages/check-your-an: The port of exit row reads the option the user chose
The port of entry row reads the port's name, a dash and its code
A territory destination country is named with its country
plants/journey-obligations/origin/spec.m: A territory is accepted where its country is allowed
A territory is refused where its country is not allowed
plants/journey-pages/check-your-answers/: The place of landing row reads the option the user chose
A territory of origin is named with its country
plants/notification-dashboard/spec.md: A territory of origin is named with its country on the card

plants/journey-pages/commodity-type/spec: An out-of-list value on save and return to overview is rejected and the lines are kept

judged.2026-11-04: arrival-and-transit: both overview scenarios come from this theme's change to the transit countries page, which now uses the flow's page gate. Overview leaves out a conditional task whose page the gate would turn away, so the transit countries task waits for a country of origin and a commodity, and identification details waits for a country of origin. Both are included.
judged.2026-10-14: reference-lists: of ten scenarios its review commit wrote outside the footprint, eight are the country and port list change reaching the review, the plants origin obligations and the dashboard card, and are included. Two are not reference-lists behaviour at all and stay out: the confirmation page's date of notification, and the dashboard's submitted date for a late-evening submission. Both are timezone handling swept in by the same spec-catchup. journey-foundation: its one excluded scenario is inc-003's save-and-return-to-overview behaviour on another plants page, so it is included.
judged.2026-11-06: type-question: its one review-commit scenario outside the footprint is row inc-247 itself, Save and return to overview on the plants commodity type page making the same checks as Save and continue. That row had no theme-scoped commit, so its spec change came in under the ticket key. Included.
judged.2026-11-20: overview-and-review: row inc-272 merged origin/main into the theme branch so its pull requests stopped conflicting with main. Its commit carried the identification details and permanent address theme's 66 scenarios into this theme's diff. They are that theme's behaviour, already on EUDPA-796 (it counts 69, 51 written out and 15 named as twins), so they are excluded here. The row stays in the work table as the merge it was.
